slides.headline: Your filler still runs.
slides.body: If its controller fails tomorrow, can you still buy one?
slides.voice: Your filler still runs. But if its controller fails tomorrow, can you still buy one?

slides.headline: Obsolete assets fail silently.
slides.body: The machine runs fine, so nobody looks. Until the part is needed and can't be bought.
slides.voice: That's the trap with obsolete assets. The machine runs fine, so nobody looks. Until the day the part is needed, and it can't be bought.

slides.headline: In a GMP plant, replacing is slow.
slides.body: Change control. Qualification. QA release. Often a wait for a planned shutdown.
slides.voice: In a GMP plant, the fix is slow. A replacement needs change control, qualification and QA release before the line runs again.

slides.headline: Make it a policy, not a surprise.
slides.body: A yearly watchlist for critical assets: maker support, spares on hand, lead times, software support dates.
slides.voice: So make it a policy, not a surprise. Keep a watchlist for your critical assets: maker support, spares on the shelf, lead times and software support dates. Review it every year.

slides.headline:
Time left
− time needed
slides.note: Time left: until spares or support run out.
slides.voice: Then run one check. Time left before spares or support run out, minus the time needed to replace. Under six months, start now. Six to eighteen, budget it.

slides.headline: Comment
slides.body: Get the 1-page decision framework for obsolete assets.
slides.voice: Comment POLICY and I'll send you the one-page decision framework.
